decision_basis: Only the existing literal P-M04-01 and P-M04-03 checks, their M04 context and selected already accepted current-candidate records. This is a check-closure recommendation, not a new execution/readiness gate.

checks.reason: The same current da0f1bf7 image actually runs the unchanged dynamic-libc C threads application and a real Rust standard-library application. Both accepted independent runtime reviews bind exact streams/status, kernel scanning and positive retirement. This satisfies the literal application-language check.

checks.limits: Complete only this literal check for the accepted current candidate. PRACTICAL-GOAL final supported-profile regression/rebuild/delivery requirements remain separately open; those requirements are not additional language-app conjuncts in this check. checks.description: Compare frozen independent expected behavior with Linux.
checks.reason: The frozen independent Rust expected output/exit and Linux result exactly match the accepted native Rust result. That is a completed comparison for this payload. The existing M04 context also covers useful file/stream utilities and representative memory/file/thread/signal regressions, and the existing P-M04-03 assessment explicitly says final useful-suite Linux comparison coverage is not closed by narrow diagnostics. These selected C-thread/Rust records do not join Linux comparison coverage for that broader selected suite.

proven_partial_scope.linux_oracle_review: Independent checksum method, frozen expected behavior, positive replay and three negative controls already accepted.

checks.precise_remaining_scope: Join the retained frozen independent expected behavior, Linux result and applicable accepted native result for the useful M04 selected suite (file/stream utilities and representative memory/file/thread/signal regressions), with honest candidate/profile applicability. Existing historical comparisons may be reused where applicable; this review does not demand an all-273 catalog, exhaustive parameter matrix or replay of unchanged passing evidence.
checks.limit: The remaining coverage is not asserted absent everywhere; it is not established by the selected records. No new formal qualification, certification or universal final-readiness gate is introduced.
